findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "streamable" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: look, audit_budget, audit_coordination, find_bounties · Private data: claim, release, write_brief · Public sink: write_brief · Destructive: release.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: look, audit_budget, audit_coordination, find_bounties · Private data: claim, release, write_brief · Public sink: write_brief · Destructive: release

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
